description: What stands between a PR and a clean merge, as the merge gate, the PR page and the Conflicts tab see it (one shared probe): status up-to-date | clean | conflicts | unknown, `mergeable`, the base/head shas the answer is for, files settled with no one in the loop (ruleSettled: each with `by` = structured (structured, code-aware merge) or rules (the deterministic merge rules)), and each unresolved file with its kind in plain words (both edited / binary / deleted on one side / added on both / rename / submodule / too large), whether the browser can edit it or only keep one side, and any saved draft. With hunks: true, each editable file's diff3 text labelled by branch name and its hunks (id, mine, base, main) for gluecron_resolve_pr_conflict. Also the exact git commands for the command line. Read-only.

fresh.description: Bypass the ten-minute probe cache (default false)

hunks.description: Include each editable file's marked-up content and hunks (default false)

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_list_pr_conflicts
